summary.headline: Malefics Afflicting the King
summary.text: Astrological judgment of dangers to a king and his subjects from malefics afflicting the king’s significator by combustion, conjunction, opposition, square, angularity, or arrival at the Ascendant and Midheaven. It assigns distress, death, foreign troubles, and regional effects by planetary place and discusses fortunes, debilities, retrogradation, house oppositions, and profections.
